slots.ev: 打烊後她一定自己擦完最後一輪杯子，冰球也是自己切的
slots.pl: 丹戎巴葛那間十六個位子的酒吧，打烊後，只剩吧檯上那一盞燈
slots.pl_en: in the sixteen-seat bar in Tanjong Pagar after closing, only the one lamp over the counter still on
slots.ac: 她兩手拿著一只杯子在擦，動作沒有停
slots.ac_en: She has a glass in both hands and is polishing it without stopping.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：打烊後一定自己擦完最後一輪杯子／冰球是自己切的
slots.of: 白襯衫袖子捲到手肘上方三指，最上面解到第三顆
slots.of_en: a white shirt with the sleeves rolled three fingers above the elbow and the top three buttons open
slots.of_s: 小習慣：袖子永遠捲到手肘上方三指／標誌性配額：吧檯 + 解開的襯衫
slots.li: 吧檯上那一盞燈在她側前方偏低，酒櫃深處全暗，玻璃把光反回來
slots.li_en: The counter lamp sits low and to one side of her, the back of the bar is completely dark, and the glass throws the light back.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「單一暖光源加大量陰影，酒液透光」
slots.fa: 臉有一半在暗裡，沒有看鏡頭
slots.fa_en: Half her face is in shadow and she is not looking at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 後製原句：「臉部可以在半明半暗之間」
slots.hair_en: pulled back into a low knot

slots.ev: 白天窗簾拉到底，這是她的睡覺時間
slots.pil: 私下 / 打烊後與白天
slots.pl: 她公寓的臥室，白天，窗簾拉到底，只有縫隙漏進來的一線光
slots.pl_en: in her apartment bedroom in the middle of the day, the curtains pulled all the way across, a single line of light getting through the gap
slots.ac: 她趴在床上一隻手臂攤開，另一隻壓在身體底下
slots.ac_en: She is face down on the bed with one arm flung out and the other trapped under her.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：白天窗簾拉到底
slots.of: 黑色的絲質睡衣上衣，下襬掀起來一點
slots.of_en: a black silk sleep shirt riding up a little at the hem
slots.li: 窗簾縫的那一道光落在她的背與肩上，房間其餘部分暗
slots.li_en: The line of light from the curtain gap lands across her back and shoulder and the rest of the room stays dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「低光高對比，保留陰影」
slots.fa_en: Her eyes closed, halfway through sleep.
slots.hair_en: loose and spread across the pillow

slots.ev: 起來以後在客廳自己調一杯，不為了誰
slots.pil: 私下 / 打烊後與白天
slots.pl: 她公寓的客廳，夜裡，一盞黃銅落地燈，矮桌上一杯自己調的
slots.pl_en: in her own living room at night, one brass floor lamp, a drink she has made herself on the low table
slots.ac: 她窩在沙發角落，一手端著杯子舉在胸前
slots.ac_en: She is curled into the corner of the sofa with the glass held up in front of her.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：她的性感是「主導權」
slots.of: 深綠色的絲質長袍鬆鬆綁著
slots.of_en: a dark green silk robe loosely tied
slots.li: 落地燈在她側前方，沙發另一半與房間深處全暗，杯裡的酒透光
slots.li_en: The floor lamp is to one side and in front of her, the other half of the sofa and the far side of the room completely dark, the liquid in the glass lit through.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「酒液透光。低、慢、有質感」
slots.fa_en: One eyebrow going up, looking off to the side.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：一句話配一個挑眉

slots.ev: 白天出門前把襯衫的袖子捲好，三指，每次都一樣
slots.pl: 她公寓的衣櫃前，白天，一整排深色襯衫
slots.pl_en: in front of the wardrobe in her apartment in the daytime, a whole row of dark shirts
slots.ac: 她低頭把左邊的袖子往上捲，抓到手肘上方三指的位置
slots.ac_en: Head down, she is rolling the left sleeve up to exactly three fingers above the elbow.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：袖子永遠捲到手肘上方三指
slots.of: 暗木色的襯衫，下襬紮進黑色長褲
slots.of_en: a dark wood-toned shirt tucked into black trousers
slots.li: 白天的窗光從側面進來，衣櫃內側暗
slots.li_en: Daylight comes in from the side and it stays dark inside the wardrobe.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「手部…的特寫要清晰」——這一格重點在手
slots.fa_en: Head down, attention entirely on the sleeve.

slots.ev: 週日不上班，去東海岸那間開到很晚的老咖啡攤
slots.pl: 東海岸一間開到很晚的老咖啡攤，週日入夜，塑膠椅與鐵桌
slots.pl_en: at an old East Coast coffee stall that stays open late on a Sunday night, plastic chairs and a metal table
slots.ac: 她一手端著杯子擱在桌上，身體往椅背靠
slots.ac_en: One hand rests the cup on the table and she has leaned back into the chair.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：她的工作是掌控一個空間的節奏——這一格她不控制任何東西
slots.of: 琥珀色的寬版襯衫，袖子一樣捲著
slots.of_en: an amber oversized shirt with the sleeves rolled the same way
slots.li: 咖啡攤的日光燈很平很白，攤子以外的路面暗
slots.li_en: The stall's fluorescent lighting is flat and white, and the road beyond it is dark.
slots.li_s: 氛圍：這一格刻意不是她的單一暖光，休假時她不布光
slots.fa: 很鬆，看著鏡頭，沒有挑眉
slots.fa_en: Completely relaxed, looking at the lens, no raised eyebrow this time.
slots.hair_en: down, longer than it looks when tied
